Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Modify Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
      |    `-- Correct the obsolete exec contract: batched mutations commit together by default, reads flush pending edits, and immediate mode retains per-call commits. Show compact canvas reads, mutation receipts, version guards, and live versus isolated-proposal targets.
      |-- [1b] Extend Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
      |    `-- Add bound AgentChat tools, supplied-edit and generation batches, saved AgentContexts, CanvasView operations, repository and DiffTree discovery, and the AgentChat, generation, DiffSession, and push route groups. Keep existing workspace and catalog publication routes distinct.
      |-- [1a] Modify Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
      |    `-- Replace the single live-or-proposal execution summary with three targets: browser-owned live canvas, backend-held isolated proposal, and headless managed-generation child. Parent CanvasView capture and result synchronization still pass through the browser; no backend-authority consolidation is implied.
      |-- [1b] Extend Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
      |    `-- Establish AgentChatService as owner of chats, turns, active canvas bindings, captured references, cancellation, generation children, and FileChatStore persistence. Its ChatDiagramTools caller resolves references and submits supplied edits as atomic batches; reuse the existing supplied-edit diagram for revision publication details.
      |-- [1b] Extend Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
      |    `-- Establish GenerationCanvasBridge as the AgentChatService-managed owner of each child controller, isolated history, serialized mutations, receipts, and persistence callback. AgentChatService synchronizes completed children to parent CanvasViews; reuse Saved CanvasViews and branching for view lifecycle details.
      |-- [1b] Extend Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
      |    `-- Place AgentContextLibrary beside scoped uploaded contexts for durable saved-context access; place DiffSessionWorkflowService beside ChangeSessionService for pinned capture and review workflow; place PushIntegrationService at the repository-event entry to that workflow. Their detailed representations belong to their existing owners.
      |-- [2] Add: AgentChat turns and supplied canvas edits
      |    `-- Attach from the new AgentChatService component in the backend parent; specify chat binding, captured references, direct-edit preparation, atomic batch application, cancellation, and FileChatStore using application/mapping/agent-chat/{agentChatService,chatDiagramTools}.ts, application/mapping/agent/{chatBindings,diagramBatchService}.ts, and infrastructure/mapping/agent-chat/chatStore.ts.
      `-- [2] Add: Managed CanvasView alternative generation
           `-- Attach from the new GenerationCanvasBridge component in the backend parent, called by AgentChatService; specify saved-parent checkpoint capture, independent child chats and headless controllers, receipts, cancellation, persisted histories, and browser-mediated result synchronization using application/mapping/agent-chat/{agentChatService,generationCanvasBridge}.ts and domain/core/diagrams/{canvasGeneration,canvasHistory}.ts.
